prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Two Pipes Under the Sink; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: One diagrammatic town beside a river, with a drinking-water works upriver, ordinary homes, and a separate wastewater works downstream. No named people. The drinking-water worker on page 4 is a woman with deep brown skin, silver hair in one braid, teal work overalls and plain closed shoes. The separate wastewater worker on page 8 is a man with medium brown skin, short black hair, navy work shirt, gray trousers and plain closed shoes. Both are unnamed adults.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One white kitchen sink; Narrow blue supply pipe; Wider gray drain pipe; Drinking-water treatment works; Separate wastewater treatment works
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: One cup; tap open; no food or trash in sink.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: A clear stream rinses one blue cup in a white sink, with water flowing toward the open drain. Exact continuity: One cup; tap open; no food or trash in sink.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions. Reference design board MUST distinguish drinking-water works and wastewater works as two separate facilities; blue clean water pipe goes to faucet, wider gray drain begins under basin. Worker designs may appear as simple adult design poses, never Kit or Zoe.

visualReview.note: Direct inspection: distinct older woman/younger man workers, white sink and one blue cup, narrow blue supply/wider gray drain, distinct blue-roof drinking works and gray-roof wastewater works. Final pages must clarify actual faucet connection.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent visual review; no classroom or physical-device observation.
